item.title: West End Tower
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Private Offices

34

Flexible Desks

112

Meeting Rooms

10

This centre is located in Riverside Towers in one of the most popular regions of Noida, sector-125. The 9-storeyed building is spread over a 10,000 sq ft floor area and provides the facility of internal parking to visitors. Being close to Delhi, the centre’s locality offers easy connectivity through rail and road.

The chic centre in Sector 125 comes fully equipped with spacious meeting rooms suitable for accommodating your team. You also get access to hi-tech infrastructure like video projection and conferencing for creative brainstorming sessions and collaborative meetings with your team members. High quality, spacious meeting rooms and collab zones ensure a dynamic work environment that fosters teamwork, planning and road mapping.

Amenities

  • High speed WiFi
  • Wellness Room
  • Private Conference Rooms
  • Office Supplies
  • Mail and Packaging
  • Community Events
  • Daily Craft Coffee
  • Community Manager
  • Dining Options
  • Cleaning Services

Workspace Packages

Coworking Space
$99/MO. Enjoy unlimited access to open workspace and
work alongside Shift’s exceptional community of
members. More detail
  • Features
  • · Full hours of access
  • · Use of all amenities
  • · Access to all shared areas in the Common Desk space
  • · Access to open sit/stand desks
  • · Access to rooftop lounge and patio
Private Offices
$499/MO. Our private offices are move-in ready with
ergonomic furniture and can be customized for
teams of any size. More detail
  • Features
  • · 8 monthly day passes
  • · Weekday hours of access
  • · Bottomless coffee
  • · Access to all shared areas in the Common Desk space
  • · Access to open sit/stand desks
Dedicated Desk
$299/MO. Enjoy the luxury of having your own dedicated
workspace in an open environment to return to
day after day. More detail
  • Features
  • · Built for teams of up to 10 people
  • · 6 hours of conference room usage ($600 value)
  • · 12 day passes ($300 value)
  • · Access hours: 8am-5pm Monday through Thursday, 8am-3pm Friday
  • · Can be customized upon request
Meeting Rooms
$15/HR Designed to give you the benefits of a full-time
office while allowing your business to stay lean
and nimble. More detail
  • Features
  • · Private card-keyed entry
  • · Flexible, rearrangeable floor plan
  • · Use of all amenities
  • · Free company logo printed by Common Desk for office storefront
  • · Lock and key entry

Schedule a Visit

Book a private viewing and let our specialists design a plan based on your lifestyle needs!

item.title: Downtown Park
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Private Offices

34

Flexible Desks

112

Meeting Rooms

10

This centre is located in Riverside Towers in one of the most popular regions of Noida, sector-125. The 9-storeyed building is spread over a 10,000 sq ft floor area and provides the facility of internal parking to visitors. Being close to Delhi, the centre’s locality offers easy connectivity through rail and road.

The chic centre in Sector 125 comes fully equipped with spacious meeting rooms suitable for accommodating your team. You also get access to hi-tech infrastructure like video projection and conferencing for creative brainstorming sessions and collaborative meetings with your team members. High quality, spacious meeting rooms and collab zones ensure a dynamic work environment that fosters teamwork, planning and road mapping.

Amenities

  • High speed WiFi
  • Wellness Room
  • Private Conference Rooms
  • Office Supplies
  • Mail and Packaging
  • Community Events
  • Daily Craft Coffee
  • Community Manager
  • Dining Options
  • Cleaning Services

Workspace Packages

Coworking Space
$99/MO. Enjoy unlimited access to open workspace and
work alongside Shift’s exceptional community of
members. More detail
  • Features
  • · Full hours of access
  • · Use of all amenities
  • · Access to all shared areas in the Common Desk space
  • · Access to open sit/stand desks
  • · Access to rooftop lounge and patio
Private Offices
$499/MO. Our private offices are move-in ready with
ergonomic furniture and can be customized for
teams of any size. More detail
  • Features
  • · 8 monthly day passes
  • · Weekday hours of access
  • · Bottomless coffee
  • · Access to all shared areas in the Common Desk space
  • · Access to open sit/stand desks
Dedicated Desk
$299/MO. Enjoy the luxury of having your own dedicated
workspace in an open environment to return to
day after day. More detail
  • Features
  • · Built for teams of up to 10 people
  • · 6 hours of conference room usage ($600 value)
  • · 12 day passes ($300 value)
  • · Access hours: 8am-5pm Monday through Thursday, 8am-3pm Friday
  • · Can be customized upon request
Meeting Rooms
$15/HR Designed to give you the benefits of a full-time
office while allowing your business to stay lean
and nimble. More detail
  • Features
  • · Private card-keyed entry
  • · Flexible, rearrangeable floor plan
  • · Use of all amenities
  • · Free company logo printed by Common Desk for office storefront
  • · Lock and key entry

Schedule a Visit

Book a private viewing and let our specialists design a plan based on your lifestyle needs!

    Other Locations

    Central Parkway

    2972 Westheimer Rd. Santa Ana, Illinois 85486, USA Available Time 08:00 AM - 11:00 PM Discover

    Midtown Concorde

    3517 W. Gray St. Utica, Pennsylvania 57867 Available Time 08:00 AM - 10:00 PM Discover
    Address 3517 W. Gray St. Utica, Pennsylvania 57867 Help Desk+ 1-800-123-4567 + 1-800-123-4588Emailsupport@example.comAvailable Time 08:00 AM - 10:00 PM Schedule A Visit

item.title: Fort Square
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Private Offices

34

Flexible Desks

112

Meeting Rooms

10

This centre is located in Riverside Towers in one of the most popular regions of Noida, sector-125. The 9-storeyed building is spread over a 10,000 sq ft floor area and provides the facility of internal parking to visitors. Being close to Delhi, the centre’s locality offers easy connectivity through rail and road.

The chic centre in Sector 125 comes fully equipped with spacious meeting rooms suitable for accommodating your team. You also get access to hi-tech infrastructure like video projection and conferencing for creative brainstorming sessions and collaborative meetings with your team members. High quality, spacious meeting rooms and collab zones ensure a dynamic work environment that fosters teamwork, planning and road mapping.

Amenities

  • High speed WiFi
  • Wellness Room
  • Private Conference Rooms
  • Office Supplies
  • Mail and Packaging
  • Community Events
  • Daily Craft Coffee
  • Community Manager
  • Dining Options
  • Cleaning Services

Workspace Packages

Coworking Space
$99/MO. Enjoy unlimited access to open workspace and
work alongside Shift’s exceptional community of
members. More detail
  • Features
  • · Full hours of access
  • · Use of all amenities
  • · Access to all shared areas in the Common Desk space
  • · Access to open sit/stand desks
  • · Access to rooftop lounge and patio
Private Offices
$499/MO. Our private offices are move-in ready with
ergonomic furniture and can be customized for
teams of any size. More detail
  • Features
  • · 8 monthly day passes
  • · Weekday hours of access
  • · Bottomless coffee
  • · Access to all shared areas in the Common Desk space
  • · Access to open sit/stand desks
Dedicated Desk
$299/MO. Enjoy the luxury of having your own dedicated
workspace in an open environment to return to
day after day. More detail
  • Features
  • · Built for teams of up to 10 people
  • · 6 hours of conference room usage ($600 value)
  • · 12 day passes ($300 value)
  • · Access hours: 8am-5pm Monday through Thursday, 8am-3pm Friday
  • · Can be customized upon request
Meeting Rooms
$15/HR Designed to give you the benefits of a full-time
office while allowing your business to stay lean
and nimble. More detail
  • Features
  • · Private card-keyed entry
  • · Flexible, rearrangeable floor plan
  • · Use of all amenities
  • · Free company logo printed by Common Desk for office storefront
  • · Lock and key entry

Schedule a Visit

Book a private viewing and let our specialists design a plan based on your lifestyle needs!

    Other Locations

    West End Tower

    8502 Preston Rd. Inglewood, Maine 98380 Available Time 08:00 AM - 11:00 PM Discover

    Downtown Paris

    3891 Ranchview Dr. Richardson, California 62639 Available Time 10:00 AM - 11:00 PM Discover
    Address 3891 Ranchview Dr. Richardson, California 62639 Help Desk+ 1-800-123-4567 + 1-800-123-4588Emailsupport@example.comAvailable Time 10:00 AM - 11:00 PM Schedule A Visit

item.title: Central Parkway
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Private Offices

34

Flexible Desks

112

Meeting Rooms

10

This centre is located in Riverside Towers in one of the most popular regions of Noida, sector-125. The 9-storeyed building is spread over a 10,000 sq ft floor area and provides the facility of internal parking to visitors. Being close to Delhi, the centre’s locality offers easy connectivity through rail and road.

The chic centre in Sector 125 comes fully equipped with spacious meeting rooms suitable for accommodating your team. You also get access to hi-tech infrastructure like video projection and conferencing for creative brainstorming sessions and collaborative meetings with your team members. High quality, spacious meeting rooms and collab zones ensure a dynamic work environment that fosters teamwork, planning and road mapping.

Amenities

  • High speed WiFi
  • Wellness Room
  • Private Conference Rooms
  • Office Supplies
  • Mail and Packaging
  • Community Events
  • Daily Craft Coffee
  • Community Manager
  • Dining Options
  • Cleaning Services

Workspace Packages

Coworking Space
$99/MO. Enjoy unlimited access to open workspace and
work alongside Shift’s exceptional community of
members. More detail
  • Features
  • · Full hours of access
  • · Use of all amenities
  • · Access to all shared areas in the Common Desk space
  • · Access to open sit/stand desks
  • · Access to rooftop lounge and patio
Private Offices
$499/MO. Our private offices are move-in ready with
ergonomic furniture and can be customized for
teams of any size. More detail
  • Features
  • · 8 monthly day passes
  • · Weekday hours of access
  • · Bottomless coffee
  • · Access to all shared areas in the Common Desk space
  • · Access to open sit/stand desks
Dedicated Desk
$299/MO. Enjoy the luxury of having your own dedicated
workspace in an open environment to return to
day after day. More detail
  • Features
  • · Built for teams of up to 10 people
  • · 6 hours of conference room usage ($600 value)
  • · 12 day passes ($300 value)
  • · Access hours: 8am-5pm Monday through Thursday, 8am-3pm Friday
  • · Can be customized upon request
Meeting Rooms
$15/HR Designed to give you the benefits of a full-time
office while allowing your business to stay lean
and nimble. More detail
  • Features
  • · Private card-keyed entry
  • · Flexible, rearrangeable floor plan
  • · Use of all amenities
  • · Free company logo printed by Common Desk for office storefront
  • · Lock and key entry

Schedule a Visit

Book a private viewing and let our specialists design a plan based on your lifestyle needs!

    Other Locations

    Downtown Park

    2972 Westheimer Rd. Santa Ana, Illinois 85486, USA Available Time 10:00 AM - 11:00 PM Discover

    Midtown Concorde

    3517 W. Gray St. Utica, Pennsylvania 57867 Available Time 08:00 AM - 10:00 PM Discover
    Address 3517 W. Gray St. Utica, Pennsylvania 57867 Help Desk+ 1-800-123-4567 + 1-800-123-4588Emailsupport@example.comAvailable Time 08:00 AM - 10:00 PM Schedule A Visit

item.title: Monarch Tower
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Private Offices

34

Flexible Desks

112

Meeting Rooms

10

This centre is located in Riverside Towers in one of the most popular regions of Noida, sector-125. The 9-storeyed building is spread over a 10,000 sq ft floor area and provides the facility of internal parking to visitors. Being close to Delhi, the centre’s locality offers easy connectivity through rail and road.

The chic centre in Sector 125 comes fully equipped with spacious meeting rooms suitable for accommodating your team. You also get access to hi-tech infrastructure like video projection and conferencing for creative brainstorming sessions and collaborative meetings with your team members. High quality, spacious meeting rooms and collab zones ensure a dynamic work environment that fosters teamwork, planning and road mapping.

Amenities

  • High speed WiFi
  • Wellness Room
  • Private Conference Rooms
  • Office Supplies
  • Mail and Packaging
  • Community Events
  • Daily Craft Coffee
  • Community Manager
  • Dining Options
  • Cleaning Services

Workspace Packages

Coworking Space
$99/MO. Enjoy unlimited access to open workspace and
work alongside Shift’s exceptional community of
members. More detail
  • Features
  • · Full hours of access
  • · Use of all amenities
  • · Access to all shared areas in the Common Desk space
  • · Access to open sit/stand desks
  • · Access to rooftop lounge and patio
Private Offices
$499/MO. Our private offices are move-in ready with
ergonomic furniture and can be customized for
teams of any size. More detail
  • Features
  • · 8 monthly day passes
  • · Weekday hours of access
  • · Bottomless coffee
  • · Access to all shared areas in the Common Desk space
  • · Access to open sit/stand desks
Dedicated Desk
$299/MO. Enjoy the luxury of having your own dedicated
workspace in an open environment to return to
day after day. More detail
  • Features
  • · Built for teams of up to 10 people
  • · 6 hours of conference room usage ($600 value)
  • · 12 day passes ($300 value)
  • · Access hours: 8am-5pm Monday through Thursday, 8am-3pm Friday
  • · Can be customized upon request
Meeting Rooms
$15/HR Designed to give you the benefits of a full-time
office while allowing your business to stay lean
and nimble. More detail
  • Features
  • · Private card-keyed entry
  • · Flexible, rearrangeable floor plan
  • · Use of all amenities
  • · Free company logo printed by Common Desk for office storefront
  • · Lock and key entry

Schedule a Visit

Book a private viewing and let our specialists design a plan based on your lifestyle needs!

    Other Locations

    West End Tower

    8502 Preston Rd. Inglewood, Maine 98380 Available Time 08:00 AM - 11:00 PM Discover
    Address 8502 Preston Rd. Inglewood, Maine 98380 Help Desk+ 1-800-123-4567 + 1-800-123-4588Emailsupport@example.comAvailable Time 08:00 AM - 11:00 PM Schedule A Visit

item.title: Midtown Square
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Private Offices

34

Flexible Desks

112

Meeting Rooms

10

This centre is located in Riverside Towers in one of the most popular regions of Noida, sector-125. The 9-storeyed building is spread over a 10,000 sq ft floor area and provides the facility of internal parking to visitors. Being close to Delhi, the centre’s locality offers easy connectivity through rail and road.

The chic centre in Sector 125 comes fully equipped with spacious meeting rooms suitable for accommodating your team. You also get access to hi-tech infrastructure like video projection and conferencing for creative brainstorming sessions and collaborative meetings with your team members. High quality, spacious meeting rooms and collab zones ensure a dynamic work environment that fosters teamwork, planning and road mapping.

Amenities

  • High speed WiFi
  • Wellness Room
  • Private Conference Rooms
  • Office Supplies
  • Mail and Packaging
  • Community Events
  • Daily Craft Coffee
  • Community Manager
  • Dining Options
  • Cleaning Services

Workspace Packages

Coworking Space
$99/MO. Enjoy unlimited access to open workspace and
work alongside Shift’s exceptional community of
members. More detail
  • Features
  • · Full hours of access
  • · Use of all amenities
  • · Access to all shared areas in the Common Desk space
  • · Access to open sit/stand desks
  • · Access to rooftop lounge and patio
Private Offices
$499/MO. Our private offices are move-in ready with
ergonomic furniture and can be customized for
teams of any size. More detail
  • Features
  • · 8 monthly day passes
  • · Weekday hours of access
  • · Bottomless coffee
  • · Access to all shared areas in the Common Desk space
  • · Access to open sit/stand desks
Dedicated Desk
$299/MO. Enjoy the luxury of having your own dedicated
workspace in an open environment to return to
day after day. More detail
  • Features
  • · Built for teams of up to 10 people
  • · 6 hours of conference room usage ($600 value)
  • · 12 day passes ($300 value)
  • · Access hours: 8am-5pm Monday through Thursday, 8am-3pm Friday
  • · Can be customized upon request
Meeting Rooms
$15/HR Designed to give you the benefits of a full-time
office while allowing your business to stay lean
and nimble. More detail
  • Features
  • · Private card-keyed entry
  • · Flexible, rearrangeable floor plan
  • · Use of all amenities
  • · Free company logo printed by Common Desk for office storefront
  • · Lock and key entry

Schedule a Visit

Book a private viewing and let our specialists design a plan based on your lifestyle needs!

    Other Locations

    Downtown Park

    2972 Westheimer Rd. Santa Ana, Illinois 85486, USA Available Time 10:00 AM - 11:00 PM Discover
    Address 2972 Westheimer Rd. Santa Ana, Illinois 85486, USA Help Desk+ 1-800-123-4567 + 1-800-123-4588Emailsupport@example.comAvailable Time 10:00 AM - 11:00 PM Schedule A Visit

item.title: Downtown Paris
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Private Offices

34

Flexible Desks

112

Meeting Rooms

10

This centre is located in Riverside Towers in one of the most popular regions of Noida, sector-125. The 9-storeyed building is spread over a 10,000 sq ft floor area and provides the facility of internal parking to visitors. Being close to Delhi, the centre’s locality offers easy connectivity through rail and road.

The chic centre in Sector 125 comes fully equipped with spacious meeting rooms suitable for accommodating your team. You also get access to hi-tech infrastructure like video projection and conferencing for creative brainstorming sessions and collaborative meetings with your team members. High quality, spacious meeting rooms and collab zones ensure a dynamic work environment that fosters teamwork, planning and road mapping.

Amenities

  • High speed WiFi
  • Wellness Room
  • Private Conference Rooms
  • Office Supplies
  • Mail and Packaging
  • Community Events
  • Daily Craft Coffee
  • Community Manager
  • Dining Options
  • Cleaning Services

Workspace Packages

Coworking Space
$99/MO. Enjoy unlimited access to open workspace and
work alongside Shift’s exceptional community of
members. More detail
  • Features
  • · Full hours of access
  • · Use of all amenities
  • · Access to all shared areas in the Common Desk space
  • · Access to open sit/stand desks
  • · Access to rooftop lounge and patio
Private Offices
$499/MO. Our private offices are move-in ready with
ergonomic furniture and can be customized for
teams of any size. More detail
  • Features
  • · 8 monthly day passes
  • · Weekday hours of access
  • · Bottomless coffee
  • · Access to all shared areas in the Common Desk space
  • · Access to open sit/stand desks
Dedicated Desk
$299/MO. Enjoy the luxury of having your own dedicated
workspace in an open environment to return to
day after day. More detail
  • Features
  • · Built for teams of up to 10 people
  • · 6 hours of conference room usage ($600 value)
  • · 12 day passes ($300 value)
  • · Access hours: 8am-5pm Monday through Thursday, 8am-3pm Friday
  • · Can be customized upon request
Meeting Rooms
$15/HR Designed to give you the benefits of a full-time
office while allowing your business to stay lean
and nimble. More detail
  • Features
  • · Private card-keyed entry
  • · Flexible, rearrangeable floor plan
  • · Use of all amenities
  • · Free company logo printed by Common Desk for office storefront
  • · Lock and key entry

Schedule a Visit

Book a private viewing and let our specialists design a plan based on your lifestyle needs!

    Other Locations

    West End Tower

    8502 Preston Rd. Inglewood, Maine 98380 Available Time 08:00 AM - 11:00 PM Discover

    Fort Square

    8502 Preston Rd. Inglewood, Maine 98380 Available Time 08:00 AM - 11:00 PM Discover
    Address 8502 Preston Rd. Inglewood, Maine 98380 Help Desk+ 1-800-123-4567 + 1-800-123-4588Emailsupport@example.comAvailable Time 08:00 AM - 11:00 PM Schedule A Visit

item.title: Midtown Concorde
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Private Offices

34

Flexible Desks

112

Meeting Rooms

10

This centre is located in Riverside Towers in one of the most popular regions of Noida, sector-125. The 9-storeyed building is spread over a 10,000 sq ft floor area and provides the facility of internal parking to visitors. Being close to Delhi, the centre’s locality offers easy connectivity through rail and road.

The chic centre in Sector 125 comes fully equipped with spacious meeting rooms suitable for accommodating your team. You also get access to hi-tech infrastructure like video projection and conferencing for creative brainstorming sessions and collaborative meetings with your team members. High quality, spacious meeting rooms and collab zones ensure a dynamic work environment that fosters teamwork, planning and road mapping.

Amenities

  • High speed WiFi
  • Wellness Room
  • Private Conference Rooms
  • Office Supplies
  • Mail and Packaging
  • Community Events
  • Daily Craft Coffee
  • Community Manager
  • Dining Options
  • Cleaning Services

Workspace Packages

Coworking Space
$99/MO. Enjoy unlimited access to open workspace and
work alongside Shift’s exceptional community of
members. More detail
  • Features
  • · Full hours of access
  • · Use of all amenities
  • · Access to all shared areas in the Common Desk space
  • · Access to open sit/stand desks
  • · Access to rooftop lounge and patio
Private Offices
$499/MO. Our private offices are move-in ready with
ergonomic furniture and can be customized for
teams of any size. More detail
  • Features
  • · 8 monthly day passes
  • · Weekday hours of access
  • · Bottomless coffee
  • · Access to all shared areas in the Common Desk space
  • · Access to open sit/stand desks
Dedicated Desk
$299/MO. Enjoy the luxury of having your own dedicated
workspace in an open environment to return to
day after day. More detail
  • Features
  • · Built for teams of up to 10 people
  • · 6 hours of conference room usage ($600 value)
  • · 12 day passes ($300 value)
  • · Access hours: 8am-5pm Monday through Thursday, 8am-3pm Friday
  • · Can be customized upon request
Meeting Rooms
$15/HR Designed to give you the benefits of a full-time
office while allowing your business to stay lean
and nimble. More detail
  • Features
  • · Private card-keyed entry
  • · Flexible, rearrangeable floor plan
  • · Use of all amenities
  • · Free company logo printed by Common Desk for office storefront
  • · Lock and key entry

Schedule a Visit

Book a private viewing and let our specialists design a plan based on your lifestyle needs!

    Other Locations

    Downtown Park

    2972 Westheimer Rd. Santa Ana, Illinois 85486, USA Available Time 10:00 AM - 11:00 PM Discover

    Central Parkway

    2972 Westheimer Rd. Santa Ana, Illinois 85486, USA Available Time 08:00 AM - 11:00 PM Discover
    Address 2972 Westheimer Rd. Santa Ana, Illinois 85486, USA Help Desk+ 1-800-123-4567 + 1-800-123-4588Emailsupport@example.comAvailable Time 08:00 AM - 11:00 PM Schedule A Visit

item.title: Reimagining workspaces: Perspectives from vantage point
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
The definition of an office is forever evolving with the pandemic changing the idea of a traditional workplace. Organisations and employees alike had to adapt quickly and with vaccinations rollouts and gradual easing of restrictions, they have begun to reconsider the concept as well as purpose of an office space. It has become important to reshape workplaces for the modern workforce and the post pandemic offices of tomorrow will have to be redesigned in such a way that it meets the changing needs and expectations of employers and employees, both.

“Working at Behub is truly a pleasant experience. I love the wide glass windows that inspire me and bring my thoughts out of the box.”

Abraham Maslow
Key Highlights:

  • We are now dealing with a liberated work environment and collaborative workspaces are a subset of this new work environment. With this trend, a conventionally popular trend of building the office first and then hiring has been reversed. Despite these changes, office is a flag that stands for stability, retaining and hiring talent.
  • Working from home had its impact on employees in terms of stress and diminishing the overall well-being of the employees. In today’s world, hybrid work model, remote working, work from home will co-exist.
  • The other change which will take front seat in reimagining workspaces is the safety of employees. Offices will be designed in line with the new reality where space utilization will get monitored, behaviour adjustments will be taken into consideration and the offices will provide an environment that yields higher productivity.

While Work from home has its positives, offices are about collaboration, engagement, culture building and talent development which is only possible with physical offices. Covid-19 has accelerated a few trends like digitalization where the new age workforce have different attitudes and preferences compared to the millennials.

There is no doubt that the pandemic has highlighted the need for innovation in CRE and accelerated the growth of trends that will carry over in the coming years. With customer preferences changing rapidly along with increasing influence of advanced technology, it is imperative for commercial real estate to take note of these emerging trends and undergo a swift transformation putting the end user’s needs at the forefront.

item.content:encoded:
Most valuable solution

Flexibility for companies

starting from

$99/MO

MINIMUM TERM

1 Month

IDEAL FOR

1 - 20

This solution offers flexible lease terms, competitive rents and locations in the central area. You can freely choose the size and locations. This is an economical solution and is suitable for small and medium enterprises as well as large enterprises when applying the policy of dividing the team size to ensure employee safety.

Take A tour

solution details

What you get

Your own private, branded offices that’s ready to move in and have access to all shared amenities,
social spaces, lounges, phone booths, and meeting rooms.

Fully flexible: scale up as needed

Add more office space and workstations without having to leave the building. Our modular designs allow you to expand and contract as your business changes.

Diverse packages

BeHub offers different packages to meet the diverse needs of businesses in an era of continuous growth.

Add-on services

BeHub offers add-on services including design and construction of Private Offices based on the working style, brand and business needs of your company.

new member guides

Frequently asked
questions

Q. Can I choose how many people work out of the
office I select? The office you select is offered at a fixed price and comes with a designated number of memberships attached. For example, if you opt for a small private office suitable for a maximum headcount of 4, you can then have 4 people work out of the space. If you require additional space / memberships, our team will happily help you determine what the best options are for you. Q. Are there any hidden fees I should be aware of? How to get started

1

Enquire

Fill in the form, we will contact you as soon as possible or call our hotline for immediate advice.

2

Discuss

The consulting process to build the right solution to meet your business's needs.

3

Move in

Quickly move in after completing the design and construction process.

item.title: Private Offices
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Most valuable solution

Flexibility for companies

starting from

$499/MO

MINIMUM TERM

1 Month

IDEAL FOR

5 - 40 This solution offers flexible lease terms, competitive rents and locations in the central area. You can freely choose the size and locations. This is an economical solution and is suitable for small and medium enterprises as well as large enterprises when applying the policy of dividing the team size to ensure employee safety. Take A tour

solution details

What you get

Your own private, branded offices that’s ready to move in and have access to all shared amenities, social spaces, lounges, phone booths, and meeting rooms.

Fully flexible: scale up as needed

Add more office space and workstations without having to leave the building. Our modular designs allow you to expand and contract as your business changes.

Diverse packages

BeHub offers different packages to meet the diverse needs of businesses in an era of continuous growth.

Add-on services

BeHub offers add-on services including design and construction of Private Offices based on the working style, brand and business needs of your company.

new member guides

Frequently asked questions

Q. Can I choose how many people work out of the office I select? The office you select is offered at a fixed price and comes with a designated number of memberships attached. For example, if you opt for a small private office suitable for a maximum headcount of 4, you can then have 4 people work out of the space. If you require additional space / memberships, our team will happily help you determine what the best options are for you. Q. Are there any hidden fees I should be aware of? How to get started

Fill in the form, we will contact you as soon as possible or call our hotline for immediate advice.

2

Discuss

The consulting process to build the right solution to meet your business's needs.

Move in

Quickly move in after completing the design and construction process.

item.title: Dedicated Desk
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Most valuable solution

Flexibility for companies

starting from

$299/MO

MINIMUM TERM

1 Month

IDEAL FOR

1 - 80

This solution offers flexible lease terms, competitive rents and locations in the central area. You can freely choose the size and locations. This is an economical solution and is suitable for small and medium enterprises as well as large enterprises when applying the policy of dividing the team size to ensure employee safety.

Take A tour

solution details

What you get

Your own private, branded offices that’s ready to move in and have access to all shared amenities,
social spaces, lounges, phone booths, and meeting rooms.

Fully flexible: scale up as needed

Add more office space and workstations without having to leave the building. Our modular designs allow you to expand and contract as your business changes.

Diverse packages

BeHub offers different packages to meet the diverse needs of businesses in an era of continuous growth.

Add-on services

BeHub offers add-on services including design and construction of Private Offices based on the working style, brand and business needs of your company.

new member guides

Frequently asked
questions

Q. Can I choose how many people work out of the
office I select? The office you select is offered at a fixed price and comes with a designated number of memberships attached. For example, if you opt for a small private office suitable for a maximum headcount of 4, you can then have 4 people work out of the space. If you require additional space / memberships, our team will happily help you determine what the best options are for you. Q. Are there any hidden fees I should be aware of? Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Ut elit tellus, luctus nec ullamcorper mattis, pulvinar dapibus leo. Q. What comes with a private office space? Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Ut elit tellus, luctus nec ullamcorper mattis, pulvinar dapibus leo. Q. Can I bring my own furniture and equipment? Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Ut elit tellus, luctus nec ullamcorper mattis, pulvinar dapibus leo. Q. What happens if I outgrow my space? Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Ut elit tellus, luctus nec ullamcorper mattis, pulvinar dapibus leo.

How to get started

1

Enquire

Fill in the form, we will contact you as soon as possible or call our hotline for immediate advice.

2

Discuss

The consulting process to build the right solution to meet your business's needs.

3

Move in

Quickly move in after completing the design and construction process.

Explore our locations

Midtown Concorde

Downtown Paris

3891 Ranchview Dr. Richardson, California 62639 Available Time 10:00 AM - 11:00 PM Discover

Midtown Square

2715 Ash Dr. San Jose, South Dakota 83475 Available Time 07:00 AM - 11:30 PM Discover

item.content:encoded:
Most valuable solution

Flexibility for companies

starting from

$15/HR

MINIMUM TERM

2 Month

IDEAL FOR

80+

This solution offers flexible lease terms, competitive rents and locations in the central area. You can freely choose the size and locations. This is an economical solution and is suitable for small and medium enterprises as well as large enterprises when applying the policy of dividing the team size to ensure employee safety.

Take A tour

solution details

What you get

Your own private, branded offices that’s ready to move in and have access to all shared amenities,
social spaces, lounges, phone booths, and meeting rooms.

Fully flexible: scale up as needed

Add more office space and workstations without having to leave the building. Our modular designs allow you to expand and contract as your business changes.

Diverse packages

BeHub offers different packages to meet the diverse needs of businesses in an era of continuous growth.

Add-on services

BeHub offers add-on services including design and construction of Private Offices based on the working style, brand and business needs of your company.

new member guides

Frequently asked

wp:comment.wp:comment_content: I am 6 feet tall and 220 lbs. This shirt fit me perfectly in the chest and shoulders. My only complaint is that it is so long! I like to wear polo shirts untucked. This shirt goes completely past my rear end. If I wore it with ordinary shorts, you probably wouldnt be able to see the shorts at all - completely hidden by the shirt. It needs to be 4 to 5 inches shorter in terms of length to suit me. I have many RL polo shirts, and this one is by far the longest. I dont understand why.

wp:comment.wp:comment_content: I am 6 feet tall and 220 lbs. This shirt fit me perfectly in the chest and shoulders. My only complaint is that it is so long! I like to wear polo shirts untucked. This shirt goes completely past my rear end. If I wore it with ordinary shorts, you probably wouldnt be able to see the shorts at all - completely hidden by the shirt. It needs to be 4 to 5 inches shorter in terms of length to suit me. I have many RL polo shirts, and this one is by far the longest. I dont understand why.

The shirt was not the fabric I believed it to be. It says Classic Fit but was made like the older versions, not the soft cotton like my others. I don’t understand how the labels are the same but a completely different shirt. Oh well, stuck with it now.
Real authentic genuine quality however it fit me like an XL size when In fact Im L. Beware

The Ralph Lauren quaility is here in abundance. My husband always says that the Lauren polos fit better and last longer than any other brand.I love the new "heathered" color and the price is always excellent through shop
My son loved this Jacket for his Senior Prom... He got sooo many compliments! He is slim build 5’11 and 150lbs ... I ordered a large ... it was a little big ... but it was fine!
